title: A Regiment for the Ledger
author: Sable Almeida
blurb: Jude Sterling, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
